# DaysBack

> DaysBack (daysback.si) is an AI company that finds where a business leaks time and money, then builds custom AI that fixes it and gets their days back: AI receptionists, website and WhatsApp chat assistants, lead follow-up, quoting and admin automation, dashboards and websites. Most projects go live in under 5 working days. Free 27-minute strategy call; reply within 1 hour; no lock-in contracts.

DaysBack works with service businesses such as clinics, dentists, salons, estate agents, law firms and trades in the UK, the US and the UAE. Contact: contact@daysback.si. Not to be confused with other companies using a similar name.

## Guides
- [What Is an AI Receptionist? How It Works for Small Businesses](https://daysback.si/insights/what-is-an-ai-receptionist/): An AI receptionist answers every call, books appointments and follows up, day or night. Here is how it works, who it suits, and how to get started.
- [12 Tasks Every Small Business Should Automate](https://daysback.si/insights/tasks-every-small-business-should-automate/): From lead follow-up to invoices and reviews: 12 everyday tasks small businesses can hand to automation and AI, and get hours back every week.
- [Speed to Lead: Why Replying in Minutes Wins More Customers](https://daysback.si/insights/speed-to-lead/): The business that replies first usually wins the customer. How to answer every lead within minutes, even when you are busy, using simple automation.
- [WhatsApp Automation for Business: What You Can Automate](https://daysback.si/insights/whatsapp-automation-for-business/): Customers already message you on WhatsApp. Here is what you can automate there, from instant replies and bookings to reminders and follow-ups.
- [AI Chatbot vs Live Chat: Which Does Your Website Need?](https://daysback.si/insights/ai-chatbot-vs-live-chat/): Live chat needs someone online. An AI chatbot answers instantly, 24/7. The pros and cons of each, and why most small businesses do best with both.
- [How Much Does AI Automation Cost for a Small Business?](https://daysback.si/insights/ai-automation-cost-small-business/): What you actually pay for when you automate with AI: the build, the running costs and your time. How to tell whether it will pay for itself before you spend anything.
- [How to Stop Missing Calls at Your Clinic, Salon or Practice](https://daysback.si/insights/stop-missing-calls-clinic-salon/): Busy front desks miss calls, and missed calls become lost bookings. Practical fixes, from call routing to an AI receptionist that answers and books 24/7.
- [Is AI Automation Worth It? A Simple Way to Decide](https://daysback.si/insights/is-ai-automation-worth-it/): A plain-English checklist to decide whether a task in your business is worth automating with AI, and how to start small without wasting money.

## FAQ
- How long does it take to build an AI agent? Most projects go from first call to deployed agent in under 5 working business days, depending on how many tools we're integrating.
- Do I need technical knowledge to use it? No, we build everything, connect it to the tools you already use, and hand it over working. You just watch the results.
- What tools can you integrate with? Pretty much anything with an API: Gmail, Outlook, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Slack, WhatsApp, Google Sheets, Stripe, Calendly, and hundreds more.
- What does it cost? Every build is custom, so pricing depends on scope. Book a free call and we'll give you a clear quote after the audit. No surprises.
